questions.solution_text:
The semicircle has diameter $14$ mm, so its radius is $7$ mm.
$A_1 = \frac{1}{2}\times 14\times 6$
$= 42\text{ mm}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\pi(7)^{2}$
$= 76.9690\ldots\text{ mm}^{2}$
$A = A_1 + A_2$
$= 118.97\text{ mm}^{2}$

$= 51.86\text{ m}^{2}$

questions.solution_text:
The two quadrants have the same radius, so together they make a semicircle of radius $8$ m.
$A_1 = 16\times 16$
$= 256\text{ m}^{2}$
$A_2 = \frac{1}{2}\pi(8)^{2}$
$= 100.5309\ldots\text{ m}^{2}$
$A = A_1 - A_2$
$= 155.47\text{ m}^{2}$
